validation_gate_thresholds.rationale: A future candidate must beat the failed validation-selected candidate overall, not merely reproduce it.
The failed held-out promotion was dominated by advection, so validation must improve advection rollout directly.
Require at least a 10% validation h16 improvement over the failed candidate before considering any future held-out pre-test contract.

next_action: Run scripts/validate_ups_advection_data_conditioned_pretest_contract.py before the intended held-out command. If it passes, run the command once; the ledger guard must reject repeats under the same measurement key.

protocol_decision.accepted_scope: May spend exactly one ledger-protected held-out confirmation after this pre-test contract validates.
protocol_decision.rationale: The selected validation candidate fits a coefficient on train only, infers context_shift from one observed transition at evaluation time, and applies roll-persistence from horizon 2. A held-out result must be described as a scoped data-conditioned online/context protocol variant, not a no-context autonomous rollout or external-paper reproduction.

autonomous rollout from initial condition only
same exact inference contract as no-context primary candidates
